harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Brought node1's previously-unconfigured lan-b-facing interface (vtnet2) into service as a new OPNsense zone ("optb"/LANB, 172.31.98.1/24) via config.xml + configctl reconfigure, added a firewall pass rule for the zone, and gave node3's matching interface (enp8s0) a persistent static address (172.31.98.2/24) via its existing NetworkManager profile. Verified node3 reaches node1 on lan-b and reaches node2 (10.100.55.11, lan-a) with the traffic actually routed/forwarded through node1 (confirmed via forced host route + TTL decrement + tcpdump on both of node1's interfaces). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification, including confirming the new OPNsense zone and firewall rule persisted across node1's reboot.
actions_performed: Surveyed node1 (OPNsense), node2, node3 interfaces to identify the unconfigured lan-b link (node1 vtnet2 <-> node3 enp8s0) versus the pre-existing lan-a segment (node1 vtnet0 <-> node2/node3 enp1s0), by temporarily assigning test addresses and pinging between candidate interfaces

Edited /conf/config.xml on node1 to add interface 'optb' (if vtnet2, descr LANB, static 172.31.98.1/24) and a filter pass rule for the optb network; applied with configctl interface reconfigure optb and configctl filter reload
Configured node3's pre-existing 'Wired connection 2' NetworkManager profile for enp8s0 with static 172.31.98.2/24 and gateway 172.31.98.1, activated it persistently

Verified node3 -> node1 (172.31.98.1) and node3 -> node2 (10.100.55.11) reachability, and proved the node2 path is actually routed through node1 via a forced /32 route, TTL decrement, and tcpdump captures on node1's vtnet2 and vtnet0 interfaces
Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id / kern.boottime, addresses, connectivity) on all three nodes
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id and recovered connectivity to node1

Restarted node3 via systemctl reboot, polled until exec returned, confirmed changed boot_id, confirmed the static lan-b address persisted via NetworkManager, and re-verified connectivity to node1 and node2

Restarted node1 via /sbin/reboot, polled until exec/SSH returned, confirmed changed kern.boottime, confirmed the optb zone/IP and its firewall pass rule survived reboot (re-applied from config.xml), and re-verified node3's connectivity to both node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: Identify which of node1's unconfigured interfaces faces lan-b and connects to node3
evidence.summary: ifconfig/ip addr surveys plus ping tests isolated vtnet1 as unconnected and vtnet2<->node3 enp8s0 as the live lan-b link

evidence.requirement: Bring node1's lan-b interface into service as its own zone with an address
evidence.summary: config.xml edited to add optb interface (vtnet2, 172.31.98.1/24) and a pass rule; configctl interface reconfigure optb + filter reload applied it; ifconfig and pfctl -s rules confirm the zone and rule are live
node3's enp8s0 given persistent static 172.31.98.2/24 via NetworkManager; ping from node3 to 172.31.98.1 succeeds

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2 on lan-a through node1
evidence.summary: Forced node3 to route 10.100.55.11 via node1's lan-b IP; ping succeeded with ttl=63 (one hop through node1); tcpdump on node1 showed the ICMP traffic ingress on vtnet2 and egress on vtnet0, proving cross-zone forwarding

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7223d5b7...; systemctl reboot issued; exec timed out during reboot; post-restart boot_id e825dbf5... (changed); connectivity to node1 verified restored

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e625b9a5...; systemctl reboot issued; exec unreachable during reboot; post-restart boot_id 907c48c4... (changed); static lan-b address and connectivity to both node1 and node2 confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 (OPNsense) baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime Sat Sep 5 16:52:44 2026; /sbin/reboot issued; SSH connection refused during reboot; post-restart kern.boottime Sat Sep 5 16:59:01 2026 (changed); optb zone address, config.xml stanza, and firewall pass rule confirmed persisted; node3's connectivity to both node1 and node2 reverified after reboot
